day.description: Day of December in the referenced calendar's year.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) URL of the article. The application must enforce the HTTP(S) scheme. Omit when unpublished. Backlink path: .url.

title.description: Public title or planned topic, available before the article is published.

article.description: Optional reference to the article's AT Protocol record, of any collection. Use a DID-based record URI. May coexist with url. Backlink path: .article.uri.

calendar.description: Reference to a win.tomo-x.atventar.calendar record. Use a DID-based record URI. Backlink path: .calendar.uri.

main.description: A participant's registration for a day in an Advent calendar. The repository owner is the participant. URL and article reference may be provided independently or together, or omitted before publication.
